description:
How to get a key for one provider (or all, with no provider): kind (free | subscription |
lease_only | payg | enterprise | media), what it unlocks, free limits, what sign-up needs (email,
phone check, card), minutes, steps, signup_url, docs_url and `add_method`:
- paste — a key the owner copies. Only a FREE key may be pasted to you (gate_add_key); a paid key
  is added by the owner at the dashboard link.
- login_link — a browser sign-in (ChatGPT, Gemini …). Give the link; never ask for a password.
- never — this provider cannot be added (terms_note says why).
Phone checks happen on the provider's own page: give the link, never ask for the code.
Public, no sign-in needed.

provider.description: Provider name, e.g. "groq". Omit for every provider.
